comments: Input facts: ego is a car initiator; agent1 is a responder with allowed type car or pedestrian; the backing group requires at least one reversing road user. Chosen assumptions: agent1 starts 5-7 m behind and 1.3-1.5 m to the right of the lane center, already in the roadway, and crosses 3-3.2 m leftward at 0.8-1.0 m/s, stopping if ego comes within 2.5-3.0 m. Ego waits 0.6-0.9 s, reverses with throttle 0.25-0.35 for 3-4 s, then brakes. Crossing traffic is exposed to ego reverse motion; no marked crossing or sidewalk entry is assumed. Distances are center-to-center, speeds are m/s, and times are seconds. Outcome intent is a conflict opportunity, without requiring collision.
